name: Exact Change
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 12 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 100 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. A college only accepts donations in whole multiples of its number of Fellows, so each donation is rounded down to that multiple before comparison; the original donation counts towards the budget. The player donating more after rounding receives all its Fellows' votes; tied donations award no votes. The player with more total votes wins; equal totals result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
